description: Books one visit, paid at the visit. Only when the person asked you to book and confirmed every field. David texts them to confirm. Pick a date and block from find_open_times; for service "package" the block is the whole day (send "Morning").

address.description: Street address and city (or ZIP) in the Jacksonville area where the car is parked.

car.description: The car: year, make and model, like "2022 Honda CR-V".

gate_or_parking.description: Where to park, and the gate code if there is one ("driveway" is fine).

service.description: package = The Full Package; plus = The Full Package Plus; detail = The Detail; inside = Inside only; wash = Wash only.

size.description: three_row only for a vehicle with three rows of seats (changes The Detail price).

name: book_visit
title: Book a visit
